title: Home Protection Plans Product Schedule: Covered Systems and Contractor Network
content:
Beacon Ridge Energy sells seven Home Protection Plans. Each plan covers a fixed set of home systems at one premise, and every covered repair is performed by the Beacon Ridge Home Services licensed contractor network.

## Schedule of covered systems and service

| Plan | Covered systems | Emergency dispatch around the clock | Target hours to schedule a technician after a covered claim is approved |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Surge Shield | Electronics damaged by a power surge (surge electronics) | No | 72 |
| Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard | Exterior electric line | Yes | 24 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard | Exterior gas line | Yes | 24 |
| Beacon Ridge Home Wiring Care | Interior electrical | Yes | 24 |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan | Heating; cooling | Yes | 24 |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete | Heating; cooling; water heater | Yes | 12 |
| Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield | Interior electrical; exterior electric line; exterior gas line; water heater; heating; cooling; surge electronics | Yes | 12 |

## Contractor network

| Plan | Who performs repairs | Repairs by contractors outside the network reimbursed |
|---|---|---|
| All seven plans | Beacon Ridge Home Services licensed contractor network | No |

## Notes to the schedule

- The seven home systems named in this schedule are the complete list of systems any Home Protection Plan can cover: interior electrical, exterior electric line, exterior gas line, water heater, heating, cooling and surge electronics. A system is covered under a plan only where it appears in that plan's row.
- The response figure is a target number of hours for scheduling a technician once a covered claim has been approved; it is counted from the approval, not from the call.
- Emergency dispatch around the clock is a feature of every plan except Beacon Ridge Surge Shield.

## Reading the schedule (examples)

- *Water heater.* Of the seven plans, only Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete and Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield list the water heater.
- *Exterior gas line.* The exterior gas line appears under Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard and Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield only.
- *Fastest scheduling target.* The 12-hour target applies to Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete and Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield; Beacon Ridge Surge Shield carries the 72-hour target.
